body.p: In the September 18, 2023 Election/Restriction Requirement, the Examiner made a restriction requirement and required an election of one of the following claim groups:
I. Claims 1-9 and 17-20, drawn to a pick-and-place system, classified in B25J9/026, or
II. Claims 10-16, drawn to a method of installing a composite part on a mandrel, classified in B25J9/1005.

On October 5, 2023, Applicant's representative, Karin Loyola, contacted Examiner Barbara J. Musser by telephone to inform the Examiner that Group I claims 1-9 and 17-20 to the pick and place system should additionally include independent system claim 16 directed to a pick-and-place system, and that Group II claims to the method should not include independent system claim 16 which is not directed to a method. In the October 5, 2023 telephone interview, the Examiner confirmed that Group I claims to the pick-and-place system should include claims 1-9 and 16-20, and Group II claims to the method should include claims 10-15.

In the September 18, 2023 Election/Restriction Requirement, the Examiner indicates on page 2 that, "Inventions I and II are related as process and apparatus for its practice", and that, "the apparatus can be used in a different method such as to move car parts on an assembly line".

In response to the September 18, 2023 Election/Restriction Requirement, Applicant hereby elects, with traverse, Group I, claims 1-9 and 16-20, drawn to a pick-and-place system, classified in B25J9/026.

Group II, claims 10-15, drawn to a method for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, classified in B25J9/1005, are provisionally withdrawn from consideration without prejudice to the possibility of reinstatement or rejoinder during the prosecution of the subject application, and without prejudice to the filing of subsequent continuation or divisional applications.

Dependent method claim 11, which depends from independent method claim 10, has been amended to add the language, as indicated below, to be the same as the language of dependent system claim 2. Support for the amendments to claim 11 is found in original claims 2 and 16, and at page 11, para. [0084], of Applicant's nonprovisional application. No new matter has been added with the amendment to claim 11. Claim 11, as amended, recites:

11. (Withdrawn - Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, further comprising, prior to positioning the main beam above the contoured composite structure disposed on the tray assembly, receiving the contoured composite structure from a forming apparatus at a forming station, and placing the contouredcomposite structure on the SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.3270.31 assembly, wherein the contoured compositestructure comprises one of, a contoured composite structure, a stringer, a hat- shaped stringer, an aircraft stringer, and a spar.

Applicant traverses the Election/Restriction Requirement with respect to claim Groups I and II. M.P.E.P. §803 states that, "if the search and examination of an entire application can be made, without serious burden, the examiner must examine on the merits, even though it includes claims to independent or distinct inventions."

Applicant respectfully submits that the subject matter of Group I and Group II are sufficiently related such that a thorough search for the subject matter of Group I would encompass a search for the subject matter of Group II, and a thorough search for the subject matter of Group II would encompass a search for the subject matter of Group I. Moreover, the search and examination of Group I and Group II would not pose a serious burden on the Examiner. Group I and Group II both relate to transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system, using a pick-and-place system having a gantry assembly, a main beam suspended from the gantry assembly, the main beam having a plurality of end effector assemblies and a pair of indexing assemblies, coupled to the main beam, a vacuum system coupled to the main beam and coupled to the plurality of end effector assemblies, a load balancer assembly coupling the main beam to the gantry assembly, and a control system coupled to the pick-and-place assembly.
In addition, Applicant submits that independent method claim 10 for a method for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, in a composite

manufacturing system using the pick-and-place system of independent claim 1, is a combination that includes the subject matter of the subcombination of independent claim 1, and includes additional method step limitations. Applicant submits that the pertinent portion of M.P.E.P. § 806.05(C) recites the following:
I. SUBCOMBINATION ESSENTIAL TO COMBINATION

ABsp/Bsp No Restriction. Where a combination as claimed requires the details of a subcombination as separately claimed, there is usually no evidence that combination ABsp is patentable without the details of subcombination Bsp. The inventions are not distinct and a requirement for restriction must not be made or maintained, even if the subcombination has separate utility. This situation can be diagrammed as combination ABsp ("sp" is an abbreviation for "specific"), and subcombination Bsp. Thus the specific characteristics required by the
subcombination claim Bsp are also required by the combination claim.

Applicant submits that independent method claim 10 for a method for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system, using a pick-and-place system recites the same pick-and-place system limitations of independent system claim 1, and independent method claim 10 is a combination that includes the same subject matter of the subcombination of independent system claim 1, and includes additional method step limitations. Applicant submits that the pick-and-place system recited and required in subcombination independent claim 1 is the same pick-and-place system recited in combination independent claim 10, as amended, with the same language (in quotes), including,
10. A method for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system, the method comprising:
"a pick-and-place system comprising:"
"a tray station having a tray assembly" with "the contoured composite structure" disposed on the tray assembly; and
"an installation station comprising:"
"the mandrel moving along a moving manufacturing line, via a conveyor assembly; and"
"a pick-and-place assembly comprising:"
"a gantry assembly;"
"a main beam suspended from the gantry assembly, the main beam having a plurality of end effector assemblies and a pair of indexing assemblies, coupled to the main beam;"
"a vacuum system coupled to the main beam and coupled to the plurality of end effector assemblies; "
"a load balancer assembly coupling the main beam to the gantry assembly; and"
"a control system coupled to the pick-and-place assembly... ".

Thus, since the combination of claim 10 (of Group II) requires the details or particulars of the subcombination of claim 1 (of Group I), as separately claimed, Applicant submits that the requirement for restriction of Group I or Group II is not proper.

Moreover, in the September 18, 2023 Election/Restriction Requirement, the Examiner indicates on page 2, that, "the apparatus can be used in a different method such as to move car parts on an assembly line". However, Applicant's pick-and-place system and method are used for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure, such as an aircraft stringer (see independent system claim 16, dependent system claim 2, and dependent method claim 11, as amended) onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system.

In particular, Applicant's system claim 1 and method claim 10 recite, respectively, in part, "A pick-and-place system for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system", and "A method for transferring and installing a contoured composite structure onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system". Further, Applicant's independent system claim 16 recites, in part, "A pick-and-place system for transferring and installing an aircraft stringer having a complex curved configuration, onto a mandrel, in a composite manufacturing system", and dependent method claim 11, as amended, and dependent system claim 2 recite, in part, "the contoured composite structure comprises... an aircraft stringer...".

Applicant therefore respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the Election/Restriction Requirement with respect to Group I and Group II. Applicant further respectfully requests that where any elected claims are directed to the system/apparatus, and all such system/apparatus claims are subsequently found allowable, any withdrawn method/process
claims that include all the limitations of the allowable system/apparatus claims should be considered for rejoinder.
